about: The Stronghold of Security's first floor, the Vault of War (Edgeville piece step 12): goblins (5, 11, 13, 16 and 25), minotaurs (12 and 27), rats, wolves (11 and 14) and the reward room's butterflies; and the second floor, the Catacomb of Famine (step 13a): flesh crawlers (28, 35 and 41), zombies (30, 44 and 53), giant rats and rats; and the third floor, the Pit of Pestilence (step 13b): catablepons (49, 64 and 68), giant spiders (50), spiders (24) and scorpions (37 and 59). Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, 2026), checked against the 241 cache's types and the OSRS Wiki's Stronghold of Security page (read 2026-11-03). The Wiki counts 45 minotaurs where mejrs saw 39; the six it didn't see are left out, as their tiles aren't known. Every wander range is guessed until recorded.
